scripts.start:all: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; yarn start & yarn start:home & yarn start:profile & yarn start:example & wait
scripts.servers: lsof -nP -iTCP:8081-8084 -sTCP:LISTEN || echo 'No Re.Pack dev servers running (8081-8084)'
scripts.servers:kill: lsof -ti tcp:8081-8084 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo 'Killed Re.Pack dev servers (8081-8084)'
scripts.//run: ----------------------- ⭐️ RUN APP (Re.Pack server runs separately via `start`) -----------------------
scripts.adb-r: adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 && adb reverse tcp:8082 tcp:8082 && adb reverse tcp:8083 tcp:8083 && adb reverse tcp:8084 tcp:8084
scripts.bundle:home:ios: rm -rf modules/home/build/home/ios && NODE_ENV=production react-native webpack-bundle --config modules/home/config.mini-app.mts --platform ios --dev false --bundle-output modules/home/build/home/ios/index.bundle
scripts.bundle:home:android: rm -rf modules/home/build/home/android && NODE_ENV=production react-native webpack-bundle --config modules/home/config.mini-app.mts --platform android --dev false --bundle-output modules/home/build/home/android/index.bundle
scripts.bundle:profile:ios: rm -rf modules/profile/build/profile/ios && NODE_ENV=production react-native webpack-bundle --config modules/profile/config.mini-app.mts --platform ios --dev false --bundle-output modules/profile/build/profile/ios/index.bundle
scripts.bundle:profile:android: rm -rf modules/profile/build/profile/android && NODE_ENV=production react-native webpack-bundle --config modules/profile/config.mini-app.mts --platform android --dev false --bundle-output modules/profile/build/profile/android/index.bundle
scripts.bundle:example:ios: rm -rf modules/example/build/example/ios && NODE_ENV=production react-native webpack-bundle --config modules/example/config.mini-app.mts --platform ios --dev false --bundle-output modules/example/build/example/ios/index.bundle
scripts.bundle:example:android: rm -rf modules/example/build/example/android && NODE_ENV=production react-native webpack-bundle --config modules/example/config.mini-app.mts --platform android --dev false --bundle-output modules/example/build/example/android/index.bundle
scripts.release:home: yarn bundle:home:ios && yarn bundle:home:android && yarn deploy:home
scripts.release:profile: yarn bundle:profile:ios && yarn bundle:profile:android && yarn deploy:profile
scripts.release:example: yarn bundle:example:ios && yarn bundle:example:android && yarn deploy:example
scripts.i: yarn && ( cd ios && bundle exec pod install --repo-update)
scripts.node:clean: rm -rf node_modules&& yarn cache clean && yarn install
scripts.pod: clear && cd ios && bundle install && bundle exec pod install
scripts.podCleani: cd ios && rm -rf Pods && rm Podfile.lock && bundle exec pod install
scripts.podReset: cd ios && pod deintegrate && pod setup && pod install
scripts.cleani: clear && set -e; rm -rf node_modules || true && rm -f yarn.lock || true && rm -rf ./ios/Pods || true && rm -f ./ios/Podfile.lock || true && rm -rf ./ios/build || true && yarn cache clean && (command -v watchman >/dev/null 2>&1 && watchman watch-del-all || true) && rm -rf $TMPDIR/metro-* $TMPDIR/haste-map-* $TMPDIR/rspack-* || true && yarn install && (cd ios && ((bundle exec pod deintegrate || pod deintegrate || true) && (bundle exec pod cache clean --all || pod cache clean --all || true) && (bundle exec pod install --repo-update || pod install --repo-update)))
scripts.cleana: clear && rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf build && rm yarn.lock && rm -rf ./android/app/build && rm -rf ./android/.gradle && yarn cache clean && yarn && cd android && ./gradlew clean -x lint && cd ..
scripts.gradleClean: clear && cd android && ./gradlew clean -x lint && cd ..
scripts.gradleSync: clear && cd android && ./gradlew build -x lint && cd ..
scripts.maestro:install: brew tap mobile-dev-inc/tap && brew install mobile-dev-inc/tap/maestro
